name: timestamp
description: When Claude Code logged the event. Tables are partitioned by day on this column.

name: receiveTimestamp
description: When the mod received the event.

name: logName
description: projects/PROJECT/logs/EVENT, as in Cloud Logging; the log ID is the event name.

name: resource
description: Monitored resource: always generic_task, with project_id, job, task_id (the hostname), location and namespace.

name: severity
description: Always DEFAULT: Claude Code event records carry no severity.

name: labels
description: The record's attributes as strings, one field per attribute that setup.sh knows of (event-labels.json and EXTRA_LABELS); the JSON field extra_labels holds the rest.

name: insertId
description: Unique per record; the same on a retried insert.
